verdict.rationale: CDP names x402 explicitly and documents both sides with the CDP SDK: paying for an API or resource (docs-12) and charging for endpoints (docs-13). It also offers an agent skill to build paid x402 APIs (docs-27) and x402 payment through the Wallet MCP (docs-18), so this is shipped tooling rather than aspiration. The story accepts any one of the named protocols, and x402 is covered. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 integration, explicit endpoint/facilitator reference details in the evidence, and any documented ACP, MPP or AP2 support for broader protocol coverage.
